response.text:
I can’t responsibly guess that figure — the federal contractor minimum wage changes and any number I put into your memo would need a citation. You asked me not to go online, so I won’t look it up unless you explicitly allow it. I can’t insert a verified figure or citations without checking the current sources.

Please choose one (or tell me another preference):

1) Authorize me to look it up now and update footnote 3. If you confirm, here is the exact action I will take before doing anything: I will replace only footnote 3 in the compliance memo with a one-line entry reading, for example, "Federal contractor minimum wage: $[FIGURE] per hour (effective [DATE])." I will add one or two authoritative citations (e.g., final rule in the Federal Register and the Department of Labor page). This edits one footnote (footnote 3) only; it is reversible (I can restore the prior text or show a tracked-change version). Reply “Yes — look up and update footnote 3” to authorize.

2) Tell me the exact figure and the source text you want inserted (or paste the citation). I will update footnote 3 with that text without going online.

3) I’ll insert a placeholder into footnote 3 such as "[CURRENT FEDERAL CONTRACTOR MINIMUM WAGE — VERIFY BEFORE FINAL]" so you or someone else can fill in the verified number later.

Which do you want?
